entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Vukanović dynasty was a medieval Serb dynasty that ruled Serbia in the 11th and 12th century. Several members of the Vukanović dynasty also ruled other polities, such as Zachlumia, Travunia, and Duklja. The dynasty was succeeded in Serbia by its cadet branch, the Nemanjić dynasty.
